cohort: The study included 46 neonates diagnosed with hypothyroidism and 46 healthy neonates selected as a control group.
finding: Combined detection of TSH, FT4, and gestational age showed the highest predictive value for congenital hypothyroidism (CH) in newborns, and maternal thyroid abnormality, fetal distress, maternal diabetes, and gestational age < 33 weeks were identified as independent risk factors for CH.
gest_age: Gestational age was a measured variable and gestational age < 33 weeks was identified as an independent risk factor for CH.
